column4: Kernel delegates to SeAccessCheckByType; sogen re-implements the same observable DACL walk: null/absent DACL grants all, AceCount==0 denies all, then allow/deny ACE scan. Status codes match.

Kernel returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER (-1073741811) when DisableAllPrivileges==FALSE and NewState==NULL; sogen mirrors this exact guard. Sogen always succeeds after that and writes ReturnLength=0, which is a harmless simplification since sogen has no real privilege state to adjust.

Kernel: ObReferenceObjectByHandle for both handles; if same kernel object pointer → Equal=TRUE, else calls SeCompareTokens. Sogen: compares pseudo-handle bit values directly — same identity shortcut, valid for sogen's synthetic token handles.

Kernel creates a KQUEUE via KeInitializeQueue and inserts with ObInsertObjectEx; sogen stores an io_completion object in its handle table, returning STATUS_SUCCESS (or STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_EXISTS for duplicate named objects). Observable: handle written on success.

Kernel calls SepDuplicateToken then ObInsertObjectEx, returning STATUS_SUCCESS with the new handle. Sogen maps the type/existing-handle combination to one of its three pseudo-handles and always returns STATUS_SUCCESS; this satisfies the observable contract for a single-process emulator.

Kernel calls ObOpenObjectByName on IoCompletionObjectType; sogen searches its io_completion map by name and returns STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND if not present. Observable: handle written on success, error on missing name.
Kernel NtOpenProcessToken simply calls NtOpenProcessTokenEx with HandleAttributes=0; sogen mirrors this delegation and writes CURRENT_PROCESS_TOKEN on success. Invalid handle → STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE.

Kernel validates process handle via ObpReferenceObjectByHandleWithTag, then calls PsReferencePrimaryTokenWithTag and ObOpenObjectByPointer; sogen validates with is_current_process_handle and writes CURRENT_PROCESS_TOKEN. Observable status codes agree.

Kernel accesses thread's impersonation token field; if no impersonation token is set it returns STATUS_NO_TOKEN (-1073741700). Sogen returns STATUS_NO_TOKEN for valid thread handles since it tracks no thread impersonation state — correct observable behavior.
Kernel NtOpenThreadToken delegates to NtOpenThreadTokenEx with HandleAttributes=0; sogen mirrors this — handle_NtOpenThreadTokenEx calls handle_NtOpenThreadToken. Observable delegation matches.

Kernel handles dozens of info classes via SepReferenceTokenByHandle; sogen handles the subset that real apps exercise (User, Groups, Owner, PrimaryGroup, DefaultDacl, Type, SessionId, PrivateNameSpace, UIAccess, Elevation, IsAppContainer, Statistics, SecurityAttributes, IntegrityLevel, ProcessTrustLevel, BnoIsolation), returning STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL when the buffer is too small. Unhandled classes stop the emulator. The handled class behavior matches the kernel contracts.

Kernel: info_class != 0 → STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS (0xC0000003); length != 4 → STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH (0xC0000004); on success writes queue depth DWORD. Sogen reproduces both guard checks and writes 0 (queue is always empty from caller perspective).

Kernel calls KeQueryPerformanceCounter and writes both counter and optional frequency. Sogen writes the emulated clock's steady_now() as the counter and QpcFrequency from KUSD as the frequency. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS; observable values are coherent.

Kernel: captures attribute name array via SepCaptureUnicodeStringArray, acquires token resource lock, calls SepInternalQuerySecurityAttributesTokenEx. Sogen: handles the specific WIN://SYSAPPID+WIN://PKG case explicitly and returns an empty attribute list for all other queries. Observable: buffer-too-small guard and empty result for unknown attributes both match.

Kernel is a thin wrapper — routes selected info classes to KeQueryPrimaryGroupThread then calls ExpQuerySystemInformation, rejects a few classes with STATUS_INVALID_INFO_CLASS. Sogen delegates to handle_NtQuerySystemInformationEx which handles all the relevant info classes; unhandled ones stop the emulator. Observable behavior matches for handled cases.

Kernel validates non-null input buffer (null → STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER / 0xC000000D), then calls ExpQuerySystemInformation. Sogen checks !a2||!a3 and returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER, then routes to the same class switch. Observable first-fail matches; inner behavior matches for supported classes.

Kernel reads the shared data KUSER_SHARED_DATA SystemTime field at 0xFFFFF78000000014 and writes it to the output pointer. Sogen reads the same field from its emulated KUSD and writes it via the object. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS.

Kernel validates handle with ObReferenceObjectByHandle (ACCESS_MASK=2), calls IoRemoveIoCompletion which blocks if queue empty. Sogen dequeues immediately if available, sets up a pending wait otherwise; key/apc/status block are written on successful dequeue. Observable contract matches.

Kernel validates count-1 > 0x7FFFFFE (catches 0 and overflow), optionally allocates a larger buffer via ExAllocatePool2, calls IoRemoveIoCompletion. Sogen reproduces the count-1 > 0x7FFFFFFu guard and sets up a multi-entry pending wait. Observable status codes and count-written behavior match.

Kernel validates handle with ObReferenceObjectByHandle (ACCESS_MASK=2) then calls IoSetIoCompletionEx. Sogen validates the handle in its io_completion table and enqueues the message directly. Returns STATUS_INVALID_HANDLE for bad handle, STATUS_SUCCESS otherwise.

Kernel: validates io_completion handle, then validates packet handle via a separate type (qword_140FC6388), uses InterlockedCompareExchange to atomically mark the packet in-use (0→1), returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if already claimed (-1073741584). Sogen checks wait_packet->associated || wait_packet->queued_completion and returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER; functional guard semantics match.

Kernel: when a1 (new time) is non-null, checks SeSystemtimePrivilege and fails with STATUS_PRIVILEGE_NOT_HELD (0xC0000061) if absent. Sogen skips the privilege check and always succeeds, writing zero to the previous-time output — acceptable simplification since sogen's clock is not user-settable.
